command: kubectl -n forum-11c4 get deploy threads -o jsonpath='{.spec.selector}{"\n"}{.spec.template.metadata.labels}{"\n"}'; kubectl -n forum-11c4 get svc -o wide
kubectl -n forum-11c4 patch deploy threads --type merge -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"labels":{"tier":"web"}}}}}'
kubectl -n forum-11c4 rollout status deploy threads --timeout=90s; kubectl -n forum-11c4 get pods --show-labels
